text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
ALL newspapers lead with the entry of Burma and Laos as full members of ASEAN and the failure of last-minute attempts by Cambodia to join the regional grouping.
-- Malaysia plans to set up a fund to provide for skills training of ASEAN insurers, said Deputy Finance Minister Wong See Wah.

-- The Securities Commission will impose due diligence on those involved in company take-overs and mergers to provide investors with adequate information to assess the risks and returns involved, said commission chairman Munir Abdul Majid.

-- Some foreign fund managers were suspected to have abused the regulated short-selling of stocks on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to dampen the market, said the exchange's executive chairman Nik Mohamed Din.
